name: Search eBay - Find Stuff Fast
description:
Search eBay Canada, UK, USA and 27 more countries instantly from anywhere on the web.

HOW IT WORKS
Highlight any text on a webpage, right-click, and select "Search eBay" - that's it. Your search opens immediately with all your saved preferences applied. No copy-pasting, no switching tabs, no typing.

THREE WAYS TO SEARCH
• Right-click any selected text
• Click the extension icon and type your search
• Type "ebay" in the address bar, press Tab, then enter your search

POWERFUL SEARCH OPTIONS
Set your preferences once, use them every time:
• Choose from 30+ international eBay sites
• Filter by Auction, Buy It Now, or Best Offer
• Set price ranges and free shipping filters
• Search completed/sold listings for price research
• Sort by price, ending time, newly listed, and more

KEYBOARD SHORTCUT
Press Alt+Shift+E to instantly search your selected text. Customize this shortcut in your browser settings.

PRIVACY FOCUSED
No tracking, no ads, no data collection. Your search preferences are stored locally in your browser and synced only to your own account. We don't see or store any of your searches.

DARK MODE
Full dark theme support that follows your system preference, or set it manually to light or dark.

FEATURES
✓ 30+ international eBay sites
✓ Search history with autocomplete
✓ Export/import your settings
✓ Title & description search
✓ Price range filters
✓ Free shipping filter
✓ Buying format filters
✓ Multiple sort options
✓ List or gallery view
✓ Open in new tab, window, or same tab

Perfect for eBay sellers researching prices, collectors hunting for deals, or anyone who shops eBay regularly.Search eBay instantly from anywhere on the web.

==============================================================================

CHANGE LOG:

v5.0.0 - Major Rewrite (January 2026)

WHAT'S NEW:

Search Options
• Title & Description Search - Search in listing descriptions, not just titles
• Buying Format Filters - Filter by Auction, Buy It Now, or Accepts Offers
• Price Range - Set minimum and maximum price filters
• Free Shipping Only - Filter to show only free shipping listings
• Display Mode - Choose Default, List View, or Gallery View

User Experience
• Dark Mode - Full dark theme support with Light/Dark/Auto options
• Keyboard Shortcut - Press Alt+Shift+E to search selected text instantly
• Omnibox Search - Type "ebay" in address bar, press Tab, then type your search
• Search Autocomplete - Previous searches appear as you type
• Configurable History - Set history limit from 5-20 items
• Export/Import Settings - Backup and restore your preferences

Bug Fixes
• Fixed critical sorting bug - Sort preference now works correctly
• Fixed same-tab navigation - "Open in Same Tab" option now works properly

Technical
• Complete codebase rewrite with ES Modules
• Removed Milligram CSS dependency
• Improved error handling
• Cleaner, more maintainable codebase
